svg.title: 03 · Rate Limiter: built step by step
svg.desc: Step 1: Network + EC2 + nginx router. One EC2 runs Docker Compose. nginx is the only open port (your IP only) and routes by path. Step 2: Limiters + rules. One limiter per language. Each finds who you are and applies rules kept in memory, re-read from S3. Step 3: Redis. Each check is one atomic Lua call over all your counters in Redis. Redis is never published. Step 4: Backend Lambda. Allowed requests reach the backend. Over the limit gets 429 + Retry-After and stops there. Step 5: Leaky bucket extras (optional). Leaky bucket only: accepted requests wait in SQS and workers drain them at a fixed rate.
svg.text: 03 · Rate Limiter: built step by step

g.text: One EC2 runs Docker Compose. nginx is the only open port (your IP only) and routes by path.
+ VPC, IGW, Subnet, RouteTable, Route 7 networking resources
One limiter per language. Each finds who you are and applies rules kept in memory, re-read from S3.
+ S3 read access InstanceRole reads rules.yaml (bucket is a parameter)
Each check is one atomic Lua call over all your counters in Redis. Redis is never published.
Allowed requests reach the backend. Over the limit gets 429 + Retry-After and stops there.
Leaky bucket only: accepted requests wait in SQS and workers drain them at a fixed rate.
+ AWS::SQS::Queue x6 matching dead-letter queues (after 5 tries)
Done: 15 resources (27 with the leaky bucket), one stack
Everything above is one CloudFormation template: infrastructure/template.yaml
